0.why: ChowTapeLoss.cpp process(): float x = inputs[AUDIO_INPUT].getVoltage(), no channel argument

comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab, doc/manual.md, and the maker's own ChowTape plugin manual at chowdsp.com. Each knob is 0 to 1 with a default of 0.5 and an exponential display whose three constants are literals at the top of ChowTapeLoss.cpp; working the endpoints out gives gap 1 to 50, thickness 0.1 to 50, spacing 0.1 to 20, all in microns, and speed 1 to 50 inches per second. The maker's desktop manual gives spacing and thickness in centimetres and the gap in millimetres, but this module's own parameters are in microns and the code multiplies each by 1e-6 to reach metres. The filter is 64 taps at 44100Hz and longer in proportion at higher sample rates, rebuilt whenever a knob moves. The head bump is a peaking filter at the speed in metres per second divided by 500 times the gap, with a gain of at most 1.5.
